_doc: The derived-copy registry v0 (plan-8018 S1). One entry per CACHED copy; checked by nucleus/copies.py. comparator ∈ {root_digest, value_equal}; kind ∈ {age_graph, sql_table, file}. writers: the ONE builder (globs). reads: database rows the builder consumes besides its roots, from the closed set copies.READS, folded into the digest. schema: the DDL that creates the copy's container (not counted as a writer). test_writers: oracles that write the copy on purpose. not_writers: files the writer scan lists that write some OTHER target, each pinned to its sha256 so an edit re-raises it.

nucleus/social_age.py.why: drop_graph/create_graph(%s) on the people graphs it is handed (astryx_social and its owner twin), never 'memory'

tests/test_branch_check_prep.py.why: creates and writes its own throwaway BcAge probe graph named by a local variable, never 'memory'
